pending_commit.commit_message: kukui: add back lid related FAFT test On Kukui/Krane, we have a gmr/hall sensor to support the lid open/close event. This patch adds back the FAFT lid tests. BUG=b:131647504, b:137612865 TEST=none Change-Id: Ic07c5c57f160e7c90cb272e02d7c3a53b6ea603f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1652875 Tested-by: Zhuohao Lee <zhuohao@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Zhuohao Lee <zhuohao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com>

firmware_ECLidShutdown: check the lid_open status after ap reboot To support the CCD faft test, we use the ec command to trigger the lid open/close. However, on the kukui platform, the lid state will be cleared because ap warm reboot will cause ec reset. To avoid this problem, we add a check after the ap warm reset and set the lid close if the lid state is cleared. BUG=b:137612865 TEST=firmware_ECLidShutdown pass Change-Id: I1d9430ba66bcd243362da9af15405e78b7681cf2 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1757656 Tested-by: Zhuohao Lee <zhuohao@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Zhuohao Lee <zhuohao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com>

tast-test: Fix arc.AccessibilityEvent to appropriately catch diffs Previously, arc.AccessibilityEvent test does not handle the diffs of event output, which results in the test passing even when there is a difference between the expected output and the obtained one. This CL updates how to handle outout logs. Also, this CL abandons writing out the difference of output log to file and now it is dumped in the error message. pd_faft: Handle boards which only sink max 12V Add a new FAFT config usbc_input_voltage_limit, which is default to 20. For boards which only sink 12V, this config is 12. The firmware_PDVbusRequest respects this config and ignores the test items which are over the limit. BUG=b:139372561 TEST=Ran firmware_PDVbusRequest on a board which only sinks 12V, and verified the 20V test items ignored. Change-Id: I08cc731e110cf4962bb5d584b1867a9fbcfc87ce Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1762923 Tested-by: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Commit-Ready: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Aseda Aboagye <aaboagye@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dana Goyette <dgoyette@chromium.org>

pd_faft: Handle new command result which doesn't output PD state name In the recent EC firmware, the "pd state" console command doesn't output the PD state name, since the time of http://crbug.com/937427 The old format is like: "SNK_READY" The new format is like: "8()" if debug_level == 0, or "8(SNK_READY)" if debug_level > 0 This CL handles both old and new formats. BUG=b:138748015 TEST=Ran PD FAFT tests on devices using the old and the new formats. Change-Id: I3ae864762d24046fe1b6604de6d3d9326e06d3dc Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1729242 Tested-by: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Commit-Ready: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Aseda Aboagye <aaboagye@chromium.org>

network_UdevRename.py: use bind/unbind to reload wifi driver Currently, RestartInterface() uses 'rmmod iwlwifi' to unload the driver module which fails because iwlmvm depends on iwlwifi. This results in a silent no-op and the unload-reload sequence is never tested. This change makes the driver unload/reload by unbinding and rebinding the wifi device itself. This excercises the proper code paths and even works for built-in drivers. BUG=chromium:988895 TEST=Run test on DUT and verify that the wifi driver was reset, test passes on a working device.
